policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This document is a one-page provisional English overview slide summarizing Japan's Act on Promotion of Research and Development, and Utilization of AI-related Technology (AI Act), rather than the operative statutory text itself. The Act was established on 2025-05-28, with partial enforcement on 2025-06-04 and full enforcement on 2025-09-01. It establishes the AI Strategic Headquarters chaired by the Prime Minister, provides for an AI Basic Plan, and outlines non-punitive measures including information collection, investigation of rights infringements, and guidance, advice, and announcements to business operators and citizens.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The overview predominantly frames Japan's 2025 AI Act through innovation_enablement, emphasizing proportional governance that promotes R&D and utilization while mitigating risks and explicitly aiming to make Japan 'the friendliest country to develop and utilize AI.' Economic competitiveness is a close runner-up—citing that Japan is 'lagging behind in AI development and use,' 'developing the national economy,' and 'enhancing international competitiveness'—but innovation_enablement edges it out because the act's title, core necessity, basic plan, and concluding model-law vision center on building an enabling R&D and adoption ecosystem rather than pure commercial rivalry. National security and fundamental rights appear as targeted secondary rationales in the basic principles and investigatory measures, while citizen concern and improving people's lives provide a minor public-welfare backdrop.
